coverage_note: Opening of a 3h01m lecture: recap of the four basic rules, the 'start with the most restricted position' rule, numbers-vs-strings, and one fully solved example (4-digit numbers with distinct digits = 4536). Permutation and combination formulas proper were past the cut.
concepts: Operational rule: start the product rule at the most restricted position.
A number is not a string: '024' is a 4-length string but a 3-digit number, so a leading zero changes the count.
4-digit numbers with all digits distinct = 9 x 9 x 8 x 7 = 4536 (second position has 9 choices because 0 becomes legal again).
For an odd number the units position is the restricted one, not the leading position.
